text:
maria: quick question — current /v1/embeddings returns 413 for mixed-dimension batches. can we consider auto-splitting server-side and return combined results? i want to avoid SDK churn for customers who paste mixed arrays into the single endpoint.

kevin: we do have a splitter microservice but it expects an explicit shape header today. auto-splitting changes quota attribution + accounting. also could affect tail latency.

sam: From telemetry POV we need visibility: split count, bytes moved, per-child latency, and how often we fallback to 413. console should surface split events on the request detail timeline.

ashley: UX thought: if we auto-split, console needs to show the original request and the exploded children. a toggle per-route/model to enable auto-split (off by default). also show which policy (soft/fail/route) applied.

deploy-bot: split-service v3 deployed to staging :white_check_mark: (sha: a1b2c3)

maria: example request I'm imagining:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "input": [[...], [...]], // mixed dims 128 + 768
  "model": "open-embed-1"
}
```
Server could respond with either auto-expanded children (transparent) or a 202 with a split_plan:
```json
{
  "status": "accepted",
  "split_plan": [
    {"dim": 128, "indices": [0,3,5]},
    {"dim": 768, "indices": [1,2,4]}
  ]
}
```
This would let clients opt into async reassembly if they want.

kevin: main concerns:
- quota/billing semantics (charge once per logical request, not per child)
- SLO: splitting adds extra work + cross-service RPCs; we need p95/p99 targets for end-to-end
- security: ensure no cross-tenant mixing when we shard onto different backends
Proposed plan: feature flag `embed.enable_auto_split` with sampling param. start at 10% and evaluate cost/latency. fallback behaviour: default to 413 if flag off or sample not chosen.

sam: Metric suggestions to add ASAP: `embed.split.count`, `embed.split.bytes`, `embed.split.fallback_413`, `embed.split.sample_rate`, `embed.split.child_latency_p95`, `embed.split.end_to_end_p99`. Also tag metrics by `route`, `model`, `team`.

ashley: Console wire proposal: on the request detail page add a "Split" badge (yes/no), a collapsible tree that shows parent request and children, with columns: dim, indices, child latency, cost estimate. expose a toggle in the route config to enable auto-split and sampling percent.

maria: operational checklist before canary: docs update (API behavior + examples), SDK patches (optional, but surface split_plan), billing rules (ensure single logical charge), telemetry dashboards, security review, rollout playbook.

kevin: i'll open the eng ticket and add sub-tasks. linking internal splitter design: https://go/internal/splitter (for context). will also add quota tests. :thumbsup:

sam: add an e2e test that simulates mixed-dim payloads and asserts final billing entry references the parent request id (no double billing). Also test partial failure where one child fails — what's the contract?  we should define: either fail entire request or return partials with per-child statuses.

maria: agree — prefer fail-fast config option and partial-results opt-in. starting a 10% canary tomorrow on staging -> will post results in this thread.

ashley: fyi — design will need a small console API change to fetch children for the parent request id. i'll mock the UI in figma and share a link later.

kevin: timeline: open ticket today, split-service tests in 48h, telemetry dashboards + billing rule in 1 week, canary after that.

maria: thanks everyone. tagging follow-ups: @kevin please add rollout timeline, @sam add metrics dashboard stub, @ashley share console mock.
